title: 4chan whistleblower: orange-light orbs scan for minerals and biologics; abduction

tellings.quote: And he would go like if you see an orange light, it's they're scanning for minerals or biologics. And if if the orange light comes up to you, there's a likelihood that you've you're going to be abducted or you've been abducted.

plain: Orange lights in the sky are scanning for minerals or living things, and if one comes up close to you, you have likely been abducted or soon will be. This is what an anonymous whistleblower wrote on 4chan, an online message board, as Chris Ramsay, a YouTube creator, relays it to Jesse Michels. It would mean these lights are surveying Earth and its people on purpose.
